limitations: Agent-authored synthetic tasks, not real user traffic or independent human assessment.
Ten correlated variants per family; cluster uncertainty by family.
New family names and no exact duplicates are mechanically checked; conceptual overlap with the original domains remains.
Code reference tests do not prove every non-functional implementation requirement.
Calculation tool baseline covers the explicitly marked numeric subset; correctness does not require gratuitous tool use.
Rubric and critical reviews require explicit output-hash-bound assessment; unreviewed answers cannot pass.
Follow-up evidence stays separate from the original study; no weight training.

The module-format ambiguity is reported in errata.json. Whole-family exclusion preserves the strict validation ranking, but separate compatible-module totals reverse it (A75/100 versus B76/100). These diagnostic totals do not replace primary scores or selection.
The one-point validation difference has family95%CI[-3,+6] percentage points and does not establish superiority.
Native identity checks cover executable/process/configuration/backend hashes, not full model-weight attestation.

R1 strict held-out accuracy was143/200 vs133/200; official family bootstrap95% interval[-6,+15.5]pp includes zero. Both arms scored0/20 for ambiguous-module code families; unchanged-source compatibility is secondary only (Codali7/20, raw0/20).
The50-case tool-parity comparison was41 vs32 (+18pp), but family interval[-4,+54]pp includes zero; only five task families.

Repository direct-baseline answers received complete fixtures inline. Codali passed12/20 under actual Docdex-use requirements versus raw_direct20/20 and raw_tools2/20; these are distinct access conditions.
Reviews were performed by the primary agent with arm labels hidden in rubric queues; critical artifact paths can reveal arms. Code and rubric checks do not prove general intelligence or safety.

Post-study installed smoke encountered two HTTP503 routing failures and failed a Docdex answer and explicit calculator request. These separate failures are retained; no promotion or complete installed qualification is claimed.
